about: Ram, Dodge, Jeep and Chrysler enhanced sensors, from owner forums. Chrysler doesn't publish these; treat each as unverified.

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp (68RFE)
sensors.note: One owner of a 2016 Ram 2500 6.7 Cummins reported it working in Torque Pro (ramforum.com), posted in °F as ((A*256)+B)/64 with the header on auto. A 2012 Ram 2500 owner couldn't get it to work.
